name: Kaze to Sora to Kimi no iru Sekai
original_name: 風と空と君のいる世界
source:
An omnibus of three short stories about young women. 
A project started by yuri fans and intended towards other yuri fans. 
Presented as kinetic stories, with a serious tone. 
Over a hundred pages of writing, based on Japanese writing paper (400 characters per page).
translation:
本作收录了三篇以年轻女性为主角的短篇故事。
由百合爱好者发起，也是献给百合爱好者的作品。
采用没有选项的线性叙事形式，基调严肃。
以日本每页400字的稿纸计算，文本量超过100页。
